programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Chasing Quakes
programme.desc: Europe has experienced catastrophic earthquakes – even though the 'old continent' is not the most notorious region on Earth for strong quakes, the danger from below is very real. Autumn 2016 tragedy strikes north-central Italy. A series of four earthquakes cracks a mountain and flattens a historic town.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Gates of the Arctic
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don’t appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Aerobatics is the supreme discipline in air sports. Only a few pilots dare to navigate a machine during loops, drops and steep flights because nausea and blackouts due to the strong G-forces can be life-threatening. But flight instructor Jenny Holmenes is not deterred - she wants to prove her skills. Although she is still a beginner, she competes in the "Sportsman" class at the Norwegian Aerobatic Championships.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: A Helicopter Heroine in the Himalayas
programme.desc: Nepal is one of the poorest countries in the world. Young women are often disadvantaged here and quite a few are married off before the age of 18. Helicopter pilot Priya Adhikari lives and works here. The 38-year-old is an exception and the only woman in Nepal who ventures into the extremely dangerous heights of the Himalayas in her helicopter.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Es el Blitz de Londres en 1940. Un anciano y enfermo Dr. John Watson cuenta a su enfermera la historia de su investigación más compleja con Sherlock Holmes, que ambos juraron que nunca se contaría al público ni se adaptaría a una de las famosas historias de Watson.

programme.title: The Tracker
programme.desc: Un misterioso forastero visita un remoto pueblo donde su mujer y su hija fueron secuestradas quince años antes.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Un sorcier maléfique, Lord Tensley, cherche à obtenir la main et le cœur de la belle princesse, Lady Ennogard. Lorsqu'elle refuse, il l'enferme et libère un dragon mortel, qu'il contrôle, pour terroriser le pays. Il jure que, tant qu'elle n'aura pas accepté son amour, son dragon détruira tous ceux qui oseront montrer le moindre signe d'amour dans le royaume.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se dirige vers la Floride.

programme.title: Voyage Au Centre De La Terre
programme.desc: Un appareil de forage high-tech est créé pour sauver une équipe de chercheurs piégée très profondément sous la surface de la terre. Ces chercheurs avaient découvert quelque temps plus tôt une faune spectaculaire, des créatures extraordinaires et des animaux préhistoriques.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: Le scientifique à l'origine du projet secret de téléportation et de voyage dans le temps du gouvernement part avec celui-ci dans un avion de ligne lorsque le gouvernement décide de le militariser.

programme.title: L'Attaque du Requin à 6 Têtes
programme.desc: Ce qui est censé être un camp d'entraînement au mariage sur une île isolée se transforme en une ultime fuite pour la survie lorsqu'un requin à six têtes commence à attaquer la plage. Piégés avec un minimum d'armes, les habitants de l'île tentent de repousser le requin, mais découvrent rapidement que personne n'est en sécurité dans l'eau, ni sur terre.

programme.title: Bit
programme.desc: Une adolescente transgenre en vacances d'été à Los Angeles se bat pour survivre après être tombée sur quatre vampires féministes queer, qui tentent de débarrasser les rues de la ville des hommes prédateurs.

programme.title: Every Last One of Them
programme.desc: Un homme est à la recherche de sa fille disparue, mais sa recherche révèle un complot plus vaste impliquant un gros accord capitaliste qui fait dérailler Chinatown sur les droits de l'eau.

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d’adolescents en vacances au bord d’une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes. Pour rester en vie, ils vont devoir se confronter aux castors zombies qui les attaquent dans leurs propres cabines...

programme.title: Les Derniers Survivants
programme.desc: Au bord d’une vaste vallée aride, tout ce qui reste de la Wallace Farm for Wayward Youth, ce sont quelques carcasses de bâtiments abandonnés. Kendal, dix-sept ans (Haley Lu Richardson), se souvient à peine de l’époque où la vallée de l’Oregon était encore verdoyante. Cela fait dix ans qu’il n’a pas plu, et la société s’est littéralement évaporée. Kendal et les rares survivants subsistent tant bien que mal, rêvant de s’échapper. Lorsqu’un baron cupide de l’eau revendique ce qu’il reste de cette précieuse ressource souterraine, Kendal doit choisir entre fuir et se cacher ou se battre courageusement pour les quelques personnes et choses qui lui sont chères.

programme.title: Meurtre à double face
programme.desc: Une journaliste veuve recrute l'aide d'un agent fédéral pour enquêter sur les secrets de son défunt mari, mais tous deux deviennent la cible d'agresseurs inconnus..

programme.title: La Colonie
programme.desc: Des groupes de personnes – des colonies – sont forcés de vivre sous terre à cause d'une nouvelle ère glaciaire. La Colonie 7 part vérifier la situation de la Colonie 5, avec laquelle ils ont perdu le contact. Sur place, ils découvrent que la colonie est tombée et qu’un tout nouvel ennemi les attend sur le chemin du retour.

programme.title: L'enfant d'Osiris
programme.desc: Dans une époque de colonisation interplanétaire, Sy Lombrok (Kellan Lutz), un ancien infirmier devenu vagabond au passé tourmenté, forme une alliance improbable avec Kane Sommerville (Daniel MacPherson), un lieutenant travaillant pour le sous-traitant militaire Exor. Dans une course contre la montre, ils tentent de sauver Indi (Teagan Croft), la jeune fille de Kane, alors qu’une crise mondiale imminente provoquée par Exor menace la planète.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: La Division
programme.desc: Dans les années 90, Rio de Janeiro a été secouée par une vague d’enlèvements. Les forces de sécurité font appel à des agents controversés pour aider à sauver la ville des criminels, mais aussi de la police elle-même.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: A sexually confused teen finds solace with his wise-cracking pet bear but everything changes when he falls in love.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A Brother in the Catholic Church must choose between his vow of chastity and the man he loves.

programme.title: Cherry Grove Stories
programme.desc: CHERRY GROVE STORIES recounts the unique character of Cherry Grove, a community on Fire Island, New York.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Do You Take This Man
programme.desc: Daniel and Christopher have to rely on their close friends and families to help them through drama on the eve of their wedding.

programme.title: Win, Lose or Love
programme.desc: El amor lo conquista todo cuando la hija de un ranchero lleva a su novio a casa para la Navidad.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: Un estudiante (Justin Bruening) de leyes se relaciona con una madre (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) soltera.

programme.title: Cine Romántico
programme.desc: Cine Romántico warms your heart with stories full of love, joy, emotion and laughter. Escape to romance with the best in Hollywood TV movies selected especially for you, all in Spanish.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: Una viuda deprimida de Beverly Hills, es salvada en un intento de suicidio, por una mujer sin hogar.

programme.title: A Boyfriend For Christmas
programme.desc: El día de Navidad, Santa reúne a dos personas solitarias, pero ¿podrá el amor superar el engaño?

programme.title: Christmas In Canaan
programme.desc: Un niño blanco (Zak Ludwig) y un compañero moreno (Jaishon Fisher) se hacen amigos en Texas, 1960.

programme.title: Rock The House
programme.desc: Después de reunirse con su antigua banda de rock, un padre soltero reevalúa sus prioridades.

programme.title: Working Miracles
programme.desc: Después de recuperarse de un accidente, Buddy descubre que posee un extraordinario poder curativo.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: Una patinadora olímpica acepta entrenar a una joven estudiante.

programme.title: Angel In The Family
programme.desc: Una difunta regresa a pasar la Navidad con los suyos.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: Un misterioso extraño y una tía excéntrica, ayudan a una joven viuda y a sus hijos a quedarse con su casa.

programme.title: Honeymoon For One
programme.desc: Una ejecutiva descubre que su novio la está engañando, días antes de su boda. Cancela todo y viaja sola.

programme.title: Mom and Dad Undergrads
programme.desc: Una madre exitosa, adicta al trabajo, se inscribe en la universidad con su esposo e hijos para reconectarse.

programme.title: Cine Western
programme.desc: Únete a los Vaqueros, Indios y Sheriffs en nuestro canal para vivir los mejores éxitos del Spaghetti Western, clásicos estadounidenses e incluso versiones colorizadas. ¡Descubre la épica del viejo oeste con nosotros!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Django, le taciturne
programme.desc: La bande de Thompson attaque une caravane ; Bill, témoin involontaire, parvient à s'échapper et à sauver la vie de Linda. Tous deux se réfugient dans le village voisin, c'est-à-dire là où se trouvent les bandits.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Adam tombe sur des Indiens qui veulent faire du mal à une femme blanche qu'ils croient être un esprit des montagnes. Il les tue, mais pas avant qu'ils ne l'aient blessé. La femme le soigne, mais le reste de la tribu est toujours à sa recherche.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Après que ses mains ont été mutilées par son ancien élève lors d'un vol de train, un tireur d'élite entraîne un jeune homme accusé du crime afin qu'ils puissent se venger.

programme.title: Quintana
programme.desc: Dans une province mexicaine opprimée par le diabolique gouverneur Don Juan de Leyra, le rebelle hors-la-loi Quintana est le seul gardien de la justice. Portant un poncho et se couvrant le visage d'un masque lorsqu'il est sur le sentier de la guerre, Quintana est une sorte de croisement entre Clint Eastwood et Zorro.

programme.title: Winnetou II : LE TRESOR DES MONTAGNES BLEUES
programme.desc: Forester, un impitoyable baron du pétrole, veut déclencher une guerre entre les tribus amérindiennes et les hommes blancs. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou et leur acolyte Castlepool tentent de l'empêcher.

programme.title: Le rescapé de la vallée de la mort
programme.desc: Une bande d'anciens confédérés assiège un fort de la cavalerie.

programme.title: Sukiyaki Western Django
programme.desc: Un tireur sans nom arrive dans une ville déchirée par des gangs rivaux et, bien qu'il soit courtisé par les deux, il choisit sa propre voie.

programme.title: Les Vengeurs de l'Ave Maria
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western ambientado durante la fiebre del oro de California, con acróbatas de circo, forajidos y una mina de oro.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Destination Pluto

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Als dem Facebook-CEO Mark Zuckerberg der Like-Button (damals "The awesome button" genannt) zum ersten Mal vorgestellt wurde, hatte er eine einfache Antwort: Nein! Er befürchtete, dass ein schnelles "Daumen hoch" oder "Daumen runter" von einer sinnvolleren Online-Interaktion abhalten würde. Zuckerbergs Team brachte ihn dazu, seine Meinung zu ändern. Seitdem ist die Welt nicht mehr dieselbe.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Das Cubicle wurde erfunden, um Angestellten mehr Freiheit und Privatsphäre zu geben. Davor saß man in langen Reihen in völlig offenen Räumen. 1967 erschuf der Designer Robert Probst die erste Arbeitswabe der Welt und nannte sie "Action Office". Eine Utopie, die es ermöglichen sollte, das volle Potential des modernen Arbeitnehmers auszuschöpfen. Aber aus der Utopie wurde schnell eine Dystopie.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Strichcodes haben den globalen Handel radikal verändert. Sie haben zum Aufstieg von normalen Supermärkten und großen Handelsketten, sowie zum Entstehen von Wirtschaftsmächten wie China beigetragen. Und alles begann mit einem einzigen Mann: Joseph Woodland träumte im Jahr 1949 an einem Strand in Miami davon, was kleine Sequenzen von schwarzen und weißen Balken bewirken könnten.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Wie wurde Florida zum Sunshine State? In den 1920er Jahren machte sich eine Armee von Grundstücksentwicklern daran, Florida von einem wirtschaftlich rückständigen Sumpfgebiet in ein elegantes Urlaubsziel zu wandeln. Mit der Erschließung von Land, durch Unterhaltungsangebote und durch Werbung trug Carl Fisher dazu bei, einen noch nie dagewesenen Boom auszulösen - und eine ebenso große Pleite.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1856 stellte ein Chemiestudent versehentlich eine seltsame Substanz mit einem tiefen, satten Violett-Ton her - der erste synthetische Farbstoff der Welt. In nur wenigen Jahren sollte William Henry Perkins "Mauve" die Modeindustrie erobern, Essen appetitlicher aussehen lassen und erstaunliche Fortschritte in der Medizin rund um Chinin, Anilin und sogar der Chemotherapie ermöglichen.

programme.desc: À Paris au XVIIe siècle, un élégant bretteur nommé D'Artagnan se retrouve opposé aux puissantes forces qui prennent le contrôle de la France. Il part venger le meurtre de ses parents et découvre un pays déchiré par le chaos et les troubles civils. Son cœur ne s’adoucit que pour Francesca, une fougueuse paysanne qui conquiert D'Artagnan au premier regard.

programme.title: Border Run

programme.title: Suspicion

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Habib, la grande aventure
programme.desc: La vie d’Habib, un jeune acteur bruxellois issu de l’immigration marocaine, qui a l’opportunité de jouer le rôle principal dans un film sur la vie de François d’Assise.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. - April est venue pour se suicider ; Krysta et Dennis s’échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens ; Peg, l’épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse ; et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. - April demande de l’aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s’il peut l’accompagner. - Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. - Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu’ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. - Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: La Nouvelle Locataire
programme.desc: Lorsque son mari est hospitalisé à la suite d'un accident de voiture, Karen, ambulancière, décide de louer leur chambre d'amis en ligne. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Fragments
programme.desc: Un jour comme les autres, un homme dérangé se déchaîne dans un restaurant et tire au hasard sur les clients. Les survivants de ce tragique événement sont profondément marqués par la fusillade et réagissent de manière très différente : la jeune Anne Hagen devient populaire à l'école en racontant sa version des faits ; son ami Jimmy Jaspersen devient muet et se renferme sur lui-même ; la serveuse Carla Davenport néglige son bébé et entretient plusieurs relations sans scrupules avec des hommes ; le Dr Bruce Laraby perd confiance en lui et tente un traitement expérimental contre la migraine de sa femme ; et le joueur compulsif Charlie Archenault, convaincu d'avoir de la chance au jeu, mise tout son argent, mais il est maudit.

programme.title: Le Quatrième Pouvoir
programme.desc: Un journaliste se retrouve impliqué dans un complot terroriste à Moscou alors qu'il enquête sur les services secrets russes.

programme.title: Un Endroit Sombre
programme.desc: Lorsqu’un jeune garçon disparaît dans une petite ville tranquille, Donald, un chauffeur de camion de voirie local, se lance dans une enquête précaire et obsessionnelle, jouant les détectives.

programme.title: Le refuge
programme.desc: Darlene et sa fille Victoria se réfugient dans un refuge rural isolé pour femmes victimes d'abus, dirigé par Bea, une femme stricte et sévère, mais sympathique et encourageante. Les choses tournent au vinaigre lorsque Bea se révèle être une véritable folle qui exerce une influence particulièrement dangereuse sur l'impressionnable Victoria.

programme.title: La Vengeance de Veronica
programme.desc: Un avion disparaît mystérieusement, emportant à son bord la sœur jumelle de Verónica, victime de l'escroquerie d'un millionnaire, Frederico. Donnée pour morte, Veronica prend l'identité de sa sœur Vitória et souhaite se venger de la famille de l'entrepreneur, trouvant en Diana, son épouse, une adversaire de taille. Au milieu de cette guerre, Jaime, le neveu de Veronica, qui souffre d'un cancer et doit être sauvé, comme Rodrigo, le grand amour de Diana dans le passé, mais disputé par les deux rivaux dans le présent.

programme.title: Sortilège
programme.desc: Alejandro rentre chez lui après un terrible accident et découvre qu'il est marié à Maria Jose, une pauvre fille innocente qui a été trompée par Bruno, le frère d'Alejandro. Bruno a utilisé le nom d'Alejandro pour épouser Maria Jose, peu après avoir envoyé tuer son frère dans l'espoir que Maria Jose hérite de la fortune d'Alejandro. Mais lorsque Maria Jose arrive au manoir, elle se rend compte que Bruno lui a menti et s'est servi d'elle.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E02 - Blue Mind (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: California Pop
programme.desc: Experience the quirky, undiscovered, pop culture landmarks of the USA’s road trip capital.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E07 - The pursuit of Happiness Pt 2
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.title: Health Explored

programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E11 - Harvesting Health
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.title: À Ceux qui Nous Ont Offensés
programme.desc: Vivants en parias à la périphérie du Gloucestershire, trois générations de Cutler, la célèbre famille de criminels professionnels, passent leur temps à planifier leur prochain casse et à se moquer de la police. Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l’aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu’il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d’art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s’effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s’affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n’en a qu’une.

programme.title: Le Contrat

Luc détenait des informations compromettantes qui menaçaient l’élection du politicien.Mais Luc n’était pas seul. Il avait élevé et formé la fille de son meilleur ami, devenue une tueuse redoutable et sa partenaire de mission.À son tour, elle devient la cible du gouvernement. Mais ils vont vite découvrir qu’elle est bien plus difficile à éliminer qu’ils ne l’avaient imaginé.Pour survivre et venger celui qui était comme un père pour elle, elle doit retrouver les assassins de Luc… avant qu’ils ne la retrouvent.

programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E08 - St. Pete NB
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Travelling to Sri Lanka at the tail end of the 25-year civil war, the guys expect to visit a war-torn country, yet discover a different land. From exploring the wonders of Sigiriya, an ancient rock fortress and palace ruin, to visiting Sri Lanka’s indigenous inhabitants, the Veddas tribe, and joining the pilgrimage up Adam’s Peak, the guys experience a beautiful and culturally rich country. They get to Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, just in time to see the Navam Perahera – a spectacular parade made up of thousands of dancers and acrobats, and over a hundred decorated elephants.

We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E07 - The pursuit of Happiness Pt 2
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S02 E09 - Thin Air
programme.desc: We travel to La Paz Bolivia to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, I visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored

programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered “super”. From quinoai, to special beans and salt – We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.desc: Comedian Rob Beckett joins Richard Ayoade in Russia's cultural capital, for a post-Soviet itinerary including an armoured tank, caviar, vodka, and a herring in a fur coat.

programme.title: National Parks Adventure
programme.desc: A team of explorers adventure through the national parks of the USA, showing the beauty found within America.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard and comedian Aisling Bea make a whirlwind tour of Hungary's fairy-tale capital, with selfies, goulash, cake, pubs, liquor, and a game of chess at the thermal baths.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade packs his case and heads to the Canaries to discover what lies beyond the all-inclusive resorts of the volcanic island of Tenerife. Making the trip from LA to join him is writer, director and actor, Lena Dunham.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E01 - Canada - Ocean To Ocean
programme.desc: Friends Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave the 9-to-5 to travel the world for a year. But before they depart, they decide to explore their own country first. They rent an RV in Halifax and hit the road, camping all the way from the Atlantic to the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.desc: Richard and Rhod Gilbert's high-speed visit to Florida's famous hot spot takes in art, art deco, alligators, speedboats, an airboat tour of the everglades - and dominoes.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S04 E05 - Christmas Special Florence
programme.desc: Hollywood actor Rebel Wilson joins Richard for a fun-packed whizz round Florence in a mini-break mixing art, action, gelato, a drive in a classic Alfa Romeo, and some tripe.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E06 - Japan - The Future
programme.desc: While navigating the extensive train systems in Japan, Scott manages to get them to the South. Meanwhile, Justin struggles with language barriers and very different food. Things settle when they leave the city behind to find the more natural side.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S05 E01 - Rome With Matt Lucas
programme.desc: Richard is joined by Matt Lucas, actor, comedian and many other things besides, for a frenetic 48 hours in the eternal city, Rome. Over a packed duo of days they cram in culture, cuisine, history, hats and as many sights as they can see.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E07 - Japan - The Past
programme.desc: Continuing in Japan, Scott and Justin seek the peace of nature by taking a late-night ferry to the island of Miyajima and try to find camp amongst the hundreds of native deer and discover that they may have taken for granted their decisions and ability to travel the world.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S05 E02 - Valencia With Sara Pascoe
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade is joined by comedian Sara Pascoe for a two day test of the mini break merits of Valencia. Together they ruthlessly examine Spain's third largest city, taking in its history, parks, architecture, culture and cuisine, as well as falling under the powerful spell of local cocktail agua de Valencia.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S05 E03 - Amsterdam With Joe Lycett
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and comedian Joe Lycett head to the mini break mecca of Amsterdam for a 48 hour hurtle through the city's attractions. In just two days the pair power through culture, cardio, canals, cuisine and much more, not all of it beginning with a 'c'.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: While visiting four of the Cook Islands, Scott is challenged about his commitments to the year trip while Justin learns from the locals how to live off the land. That is until his love for animals is challenged by “the head hunters” – the local school boys, who take the guys on a traditional pig hunt.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S05 E04 - Stockholm With Sally Phillips
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and actress Sally Phillips head to Stockholm for a fulsome 48 hours in the Swedish capital. Together they scale rooftops, sing Abba, eat Swedish-Danish, and stay up late playing on their phones.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E01 - Adventure Without Money Or Maps
programme.desc: If you were tasked to race across the world with limited cash and nothing in the way of modern technology, how do you think you’d fare? BBC2’s Race Across the World returns, as five teams attempt just that. This series takes viewers on the trip of a lifetime, following our contestants as they embark on an epic and adrenaline-fuelled adventure, travelling into the unknown without the trappings of modern life.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E09 - New Zealand - Risks & Rewards
programme.desc: Adventure in New Zealand does not come without consequences, especially when Scott and Justin meet up with their “larger than life” kiwi friend Ellis. Justin’s competitive risk-taking side takes over, while Scott deals with his own fears.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S01 E10 - New Zealand - Untouched
programme.desc: Christmas approaches as Scott and Justin continue their travels through untouched New Zealand. Finding adventure and uninhabited landscape reminds them of how long they’ve been on the road and of all the family and friends waiting for their return.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E02 - Southbound Race Without Modern Comforts NB
programme.desc: Five teams have been set the challenge to travel from the top to the bottom of Latin America - leaving behind smartphones, internet access and credit cards and armed with only the cash equivalent of a one-way airfare from Mexico City to Ushuaia.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Nearing the end of the trip, Scott and Justin fly to Thailand looking for unique experiences outside of traditional tourist stops, from the hill tribes of the north to the sun-drenched kickboxing rings of the south.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E03 - From Mexico To Ushuaia Unplugged NB
programme.desc: Five teams have been set the challenge to travel from the top to the bottom of Latin America - leaving behind smartphones, internet access and credit cards and armed with only the cash equivalent of a one-way airfare from Mexico City to Ushuaia.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Sarorn and his family who show them the real side of Cambodia. The villages, the poverty, and the amazing people. The guys find new purpose with their year long travel and commit to another year-long trip.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E04 - High Stakes In High Altitudes NB
programme.desc: As the 25,000 km race to Ushuaia approaches the half-way mark, the four teams compete not just with each other, but with the extreme altitudes of Peru.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Justin has been travelling alone for the past couple of months when Scott and Andre decide to come meet him at a festival in Spain. They head to Gibraltar, where Justin is attacked by candy-stealing Apes, before hopping on a ferry and completely switching continents. Now in Morocco, they head inland towards Fès, then further into the snow-covered Atlas Mountains to stay in a traditional Moroccan kasbah. They end their trip with a long climb up Jbel Toubkal – the highest mountain in North Africa. Three strong again, they find reason to keep travelling together.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E05 - Racing Heights Through Peruvian Peaks NB
programme.desc: As the 25,000 km race to Ushuaia approaches the half-way mark, the four teams compete not just with each other, but with the extreme altitudes of Peru.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: After many visa difficulties, Scott and Justin are finally allowed to enter Libya. They travel from Tripoli to Jebel Nafusa, before getting lost in the abandoned city of Ghadames. They wander around the maze of empty streets and homes before finding each other again, and drive deep into the Sahara desert to climb some of the world’s largest sand dunes, and sand-board in their own private oasis.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E03 - Brazil - Piranha Soup
programme.desc: The guys reunite with Gisele, whom they had met on their previous trip to Jordan. A native to Brazil, Gisele shows them around Rio de Janeiro. She takes them hang gliding, to a football match, and into the ghettos before they hit the road for the Pantanal. Here they find poisonous plants, the worlds largest living rodents, and catch piranha for lunch - none of the reasons why Justin ends up in the hospital. This is a great opportunity for the guys to learn about Brazil’s dangers before reaching the Amazon.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E06 - Falling Behind, Fighting To Return NB
programme.desc: With three teams at the checkpoint – Cafayate in Argentina - one team is yet to arrive. Dom and Lizzie are over 24 hours behind their competitors and after a disastrous last leg, they must rely on all their ingenuity to claw their way back into the race.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E04 - Brazil - Treading Water
programme.desc: There are so many things that can kill you in the Amazon. The guys rent a boat as protection and head down river to explore the rainforest. They find poisonous insects, angry snakes, and natives living in hand-built huts. After getting stuck in a 70 meter high tree in an Amazonian thunderstorm, and attacked by vicious pink dolphins, they hop on a plane headed for the island of Fernando de Noronha. Here they try their hand at scuba diving and witness the hatching of close to 1000 baby sea turtles. The dynamic changes when Justin and Gisele know their time together will soon be ending.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E07 - Jungle Run Versus Bay Paddle NB
programme.desc: With two teams at the checkpoint –Ilha Grande in Brazil – the two remaining teams are engaged in a frantic race to avoid finishing the leg in last place. Dom and Lizzie are on foot, running through the jungle whilst Jo and Sam are paddling furiously in a canoe across the bay. It’s a nail-biting ending and the siblings just manage to edge out their rivals and sign into the book.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They’re looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer’s home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won’t end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro’s remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S02 E08 - Final Push To The Edge NB
programme.desc: After twenty-one thousand kilometres, two continents and seventeen countries. The teams embark on the final leg of their epic journey. However, a mammoth 4800km still stands between them and the finish line of Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: The Private Secretary
programme.desc: Pamela and Sterling are the married owners of a thriving tech empire, where they have all the power and money in the world. As the demands of their business have grown, they bring on Vanessa, a high efficient and enigmatic private secretary. What initially seems as a godsend, Vanessa soon begins to dive further into their lives, and has an agenda that could bring their empire to ruin.

programme.title: The Struggle
programme.desc: A story about Debra and her daughter, Tracey struggling in the heart of Memphis. Debra tries to keep her daughter out of danger and off the streets but it doesn't help with the surrounding of drug dealers, pimps and prostitution. It gets worst when Erin and her gang interfere in situations with Tracey and Kandi. That's when Tracey takes matters in her own hands.

programme.title: The Struggle 2: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Darnell gets released from jail and tries to take back control of his territory. Now that Tracey has left and moved to Atlanta with her mom...her sister Stacey is seeking revenge.

programme.title: Three Secrets
programme.desc: Struck with the grief after losing her child, Naomi is stuck in a depression while her husband begins to stray from their marriage. Hoping to bring life back into their boring marriage, he invites her to go out with him and they meet a mysterious woman who joins them for the evening. As events unfold She finds herself in an unexpected entanglement built on lies.

programme.title: Melted Lipstick
programme.desc: Riley Davis, a young woman in her twenties, who navigates through life fraught with insecurities about her body, self-esteem issues. Her life takes a mystical turn when she encounters an enigmatic voodoo doctor who gifts her a special lipstick, claiming that it holds the power to transform her into anyone she desires when applied. However, Riley soon learn that all magic comes for a price, as she goes down a dangerous and deadly path of destruction.

programme.title: Platinum
programme.desc: A mysterious man arrives in Houston, and gets the opportunity of a lifetime, when ICE, a pretty hooker with considerable business acumen, gives him the name Platinum and teaches him the pimp game. Platinum quickly becomes the coldest pimp in the city, until his disturbing past catches up to him, and he kills the niece of a very powerful drug dealer, THE WORD. The Word wastes no time aiming his revenge at Platinum, and everyone he knows.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House
programme.desc: When Kionna is asked to step in and take control of her jailed boyfriend, Tyreek's, drug empire, she reluctantly agrees, but her new position as Queen of the Trap House suits her more than expected.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends—DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine—are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Mercedes Benz feiert 125 Jahre Automobilgeschichte. Der Markenname ergibt sich erst 1926 aus dem Zusammenschluss der Marken Mercedes, der Daimler-Motoren-Gesellschaft, und Benz. Neben der großen Qualität stehen Mercedes-Benz-Fahrzeuge auch für Sicherheit. Der Mercedes-Stern ist das wichtigste Kennzeichen der Mercedes-Benz-Autos. Der Name 'Mercedes-Benz' gilt auf der ganzen Welt als Inbegriff für Tradition und Innovation für die Zukunft des Automobils.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Alpina - dieser Name steht für modernste Entwicklung, Präzision im Motorbau und feinste Materialien. Am Standort Buchloe sorgt Alpina für hochwertiges BMW-Tuning und erfolgreichen Motorsport, sowie - überraschender Weise - für spezielle Weine. Firmengründer Burkard Bovensiepen legt in den 60er Jahren den Grundstein hierzu. Heute führt er gemeinsam mit seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian dieses Gesamtkunstwerk.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Etwas Metall, ein wenig Leder, und ein paar Stücke Stoff. Nur 10 Kilo Abfall entsteht heutzutage bei der Produktion eines 3er BMW. So produziert das Münchener Presswerk täglich mehr als 600 Tonnen Blech. Das meiste davon landet wirklich im fertigen Fahrzeug. Die Rolls Royce-Fabrik in Goodwood, England: Als ein Teil der BMW Group, arbeitet Rolls Royce bei der Produktion selbstverständlich nach den gleichen Prinzipien.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Ende 2001 startet ein neues Kapitel der Automobilgeschichte. Volkswagen will von nun an in der Oberklasse mitmischen. Die Geburtsstunde des VW Phaeton. Er bekommt eine eigene gläserne Manufaktur. Mitten in Dresden entsteht für rund 187 Millionen Euro eine 55.000 Quadratmeter große Produktionsstätte, in der das Topmodell der Wolfsburger in Handarbeit gefertigt wird.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Der VW Bulli war eins der Symbole des Deutschen Wirtschaftswunders. Seit 1956 läuft der beliebte Transporter in Hannover vom Band. Der VW California Camping-Bus wird in einer Spezialfabrik unweit des Stammwerks gebaut.

programme.title: Ein ganz spezieller Traumwagen: Der Ferrari 458 Speciale
programme.desc: Der 458 Speciale ist eine Fahrmaschine vor dem Herrn. 2,4 Kilogramm pro PS sind eine Ansage an die Sportwagen-Welt. Im Motorvisions-Test lasst er seine Pferde von der Leine.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: Nick Uhas und seine Gäste ergründen, wie Theremine funktionieren und wie das Außenohr das menschliche Gehör beeinflusst. Außerdem zeigen sie, wie man mit Hilfe der Kymatik Geräusche sichtbar machen kann – ein wahres Fest für die Sinne.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: Nick Uhas und seine Gäste zeigen in aufregenden Experimenten, wie man eine glühende Gurke herstellt, wie Forensiker DNS extrahieren und wie Säuren einfache Haushaltsgegenstände grundlegend verändern können.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: Nick Uhas und seine Gäste wollen mithilfe von Lithium den Urknall nachbilden, die Brandkraft von Methan untersuchen, und zeigen, wie bereits eine kleine Menge verflüssigter Stickstoff einer Rakete eine Menge Kraft verleihen kann.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: In unterhaltsamen Experimenten lassen wir Feuerwerkskörper aus Zinnfolie entstehen, stellen ein übelriechendes Polymer her und befassen uns mit einem Grundprinzip der Alchemie: Blei in Gold zu verwandeln.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
